shared_armed_on_keeper.exclusion_reason: run identity, not a mechanism: a backcast pins the weather year to the solve year by construction (ScenarioConfig.mode='backcast'), so every multi-year bundle necessarily records a non-default value for two of its three years. Nothing is armed and nothing is tunable — the pinning IS the backcast, and it is already governed by rule 13 [R-MEASURED] and the mode field rather than by a matrix cell.
